Solaris BioMed — identity (2024).

An eagle drawn inside a brushed ring of sun, graded from red-orange at the left edge to gold at the right, over a wide-tracked SOLARIS wordmark. The ring stays open where the eagle breaks through it, so the bird reads as rising out of the light rather than stamped onto a badge.

One drawing carries the rest of the system: the reversed lockup on plum, a pale watermark, the letterhead.

Identity design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·78.
